answer: Lock work history for 30 epochs and claw back 100 percent on a replayed submission. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by name, so renaming a clone at the inlet changes nothing. A farm of 900 identities must hold 900 histories for 30 epochs, which is 27,000 identity-epochs of collateral before the first payout. The replay log is the only signal; a wharf full of aliases leaves the same trace and the same zero balance.
